important_findings.finding: The new readiness regression test is not in package.json test:focused-acceptance. Both .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/focused-acceptance.yml run that explicit script. The automatic focused CI result can therefore pass while the replacement-tab wait is absent or broken.
important_findings.remedy: Add tests/browser/settings-replacement-tab.test.mjs to test:focused-acceptance, then run that exact script and the automatic focused workflow.

passing_observations: Direct node --test of settings-replacement-tab.test.mjs and settings-reload-boundary.test.mjs passed 6/6 locally; the missing-tab negative case rejects as intended.
The new readiness condition uses the existing evaluate/waitFor seam and does not alter trusted click dispatch, guest-state acceptance, or timeouts.

The new diagnostic stage is allowlisted. Readiness timeout is classified as settings_tab_not_ready, and receipt fields remain fixed safe values; raw transient error text is not emitted by the classifier.
The diagnosis report correctly calls the timing cause supported rather than established and keeps native product recovery pending.
verdict_b_quality.further_limit: The direct regression test exercises the DOM-readiness seam with controlled panel states, not the real extension reload; native verification remains necessary.
